name: superdesign
description: Design or redesign frontend UI, presentations, and graphics on the Superdesign canvas with a choice of leading AI models. Use whenever the user wants to design a page, feature, flow, slide deck, or brand-new product; improve or reproduce existing UI; compare design results across top models; explore visual variants; set or extract a design system; build reusable components or multi-page flows; create presentations; or create posters and marketing graphics, even if they never say the word 'design
author: superdesigndev
summary_zh: 一款支持多种主流 AI 模型的可视化设计工具，适合创建或改版界面、演示文稿、海报及多页面产品流程。
